The '''Sisters of the Machinesmith''' were a semi-religious group of weapons manufacturers associated with the [[Waymancy Hollow]]. After studying [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] technology in isolation in the Waymancy Hollow for a thousand years, the Sisters of the Machinesmith produced the extremely efficient [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] used by the [[Signatories of Waymancy]] during the [[Waymancy Storm]], a short, destructive war with the Republic in [[7811 BBY]]. These generators allowed Waymancy [[Pulse-wave blaster|pulse-wave weapons]] to be more powerful and have much faster rates of fire than anything known by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] at the time of the [[Subterra Period]].
